id: title:adboio:accept the proxy issuer as a client assertion audience

This supports the implementation of a broader identity/authentication capability.

observations.behavior: Adds a constant for maximum audience length and a new helper to unverified JWT claims.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to bound the length of audience claims logged during client assertion rejection, supporting the implementation of a new audience resolution mechanism.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper to unverified JWT claims and updates the unverified subject extraction to use it.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to extract the subject claim from a JWT without verifying the signature, supporting the implementation of a new audience resolution mechanism.
